models_evaluated: four previously validated EHR-based machine-learning and regression pancreatic cancer risk models

links.outcome: Enrollment and completion of imaging and CA19-9 workup among patients flagged high-risk by prediction models
links.effect: Of 1,251 eligible high-risk patients, 102 (8.2%) enrolled; 87% completed baseline imaging, 96% completed CA19-9; 79% completed both at 18 months; 10% needed further evaluations.
links.quote: At baseline, 89 (87%) completed imaging and 98 (96%) completed CA19-9.

unlisted_practices: Combining EHR-based risk prediction with imaging and CA19-9 surveillance for early cancer detection

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluates a real-world clinical implementation and workflow feasibility (enrollment, completion rates, incidental findings) of deploying an EHR-based predictive risk model to trigger screening.

primary.practice: AI-guided screening and surveillance workflow with downstream imaging and biomarker testing
